{{Top|leg}}
A '''Mutual Claim Registration''' was declared when multiple [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] laid claim to a new [[Star system/Legends|star system]] or [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Under the [[Code of the Claim]], the scouts split the reward for the new discovery amongst themselves.
